answer: Reputation accrues as integral of stake × time: rep = Σ stake_i × (1 - decay)^(epochs_elapsed). New identity starts at 0, needs 20 epochs to reach voting threshold 90. Attacker with N identities must maintain N × 500 stake for 20 epochs, opportunity cost = N × 500 × APY × 20/365. Verification: on-chain stake snapshots each epoch, reputation updated via Merkle root. Sybil cost grows superlinearly due to decay compounding. Words: gale, reef, whisper.
